comment: Universal cab sim: 741 input buffer, TL072 presence stage, diode-clipping RC filter ladder, depth/mid stage and Sallen-Key low-pass outputs, plus a 2N3906 flasher for a bicolor LED; four TL072 sections counted as two chips.
uncertain: Pres/Depth/Master/Amp/Line pots: no taper drawn, all drawn with the same T-wiper symbol (Pres/Depth could be trimmers)
IN/BUFFER/AMP/LINE: drawn as 3-pole switch symbols with two poles grounded; may represent switched jacks rather than 3PDT switches
rows: bicolor (two-colour antiparallel) LED, driven by the flasher
four TL072 sections drawn = two dual chips
